about: The key routes whose first view the build measures (guard-route-first-views in vite.config.ts, judgeRoute in client/src/lib/bootSet.ts).
A first view is every chunk index.html loads plus the page chunk and its static imports, which route-preload.js asks for.
everyPage lists the lazy pieces the shell draws on every page (the root strip under the header); each route counts them too, and nothing they reach joins a merged group either.
maxGzipKB is the gzipped JS of that set (gzip -9 of each chunk). known lists modules that ride the view without being imported by the entry or the page: a ratchet, so it only ever shrinks.

Set on 2026-11-14 at the measured figure plus about 10 KB: 247.7 (/), 373.0 (/roles), 300.2 (/propose-a-role), 269.8 (/steward). The same measure on the tree before the page speed pass read 423.5, 493.5, 447.4 and 433.5. Never raise a number to make a build pass.
